note: Register of tabnas runtime dependencies that differ between this repository's ports (tabnas/admin ADR-24). tools/port-deps.cjs fails on a difference that is not listed here, and on an entry that no longer matches the manifests, so the list cannot outlive what it records. Every entry states the ports that have the dependency today, the reason, and the repair.

parser.reason: TypeScript: ts/package.json lists '@tabnas/parser' as a peer although no file in ts/src imports it. The command compiles programs with @tabnas/alchemy's language, which imports the engine (alchemy ts/src/grammar.ts), and since 2026-10-06 alchemy declares the engine as an OPTIONAL peer so that packages taking only @tabnas/alchemy/shared do not install it; npm does not install an optional peer, so the host that loads the language declares it. Go and Rust need no declaration: a module or crate brings its own requirements, so github.com/tabnas/alchemy/go and tabnas-alchemy bring the engine to this command transitively.
parser.repair: None is owed: the difference is npm's packaging, not the code. It goes away only if alchemy's engine peer becomes required again (undoing the install-footprint change) or npm installs optional peers. Ruled intentional by the maintainer on 2026-10-06: an npm packaging difference (alchemy's engine peer is optional, so the host that runs the language declares it); the difference stays and no repair is owed.
